英文原标题：FOMO Crypto App's $500 Creator Pay Draws Mixed Reactions（中文为 AI 翻译，仅供参考）

A $500 monthly retainer for 30 videos sounded like a steal to some creators, but others saw it as a raw deal from a fast-growing app.

FOMO, a social crypto trading app with 2.7 million users, offered creators $500 a month plus referral commissions to post 30 original videos across new TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube accounts. Critics like creator Eliza called it lowballing, especially compared to seven-figure deals for big influencers, while defenders highlighted quick video production and real earnings potential from referrals—some hitting over $100,000. FOMO's UGC head clarified it was a demo offer, with many creators happy thanks to backend commissions that have even paid off loans.
